Definition: Bani, the name of five Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Bani = "built"; 1) a Gadite, one of David's mighty warriors; 2) a Levite of the line of Merari, and forefather to Ethan; 3) a man of Judah of the line of Pharez; 4) "children of Bani" returned from captivity with Zerubbabel; 5) one or up to three Levites in Nehemiah's time
